svg.title: Range of a projectile on level ground
svg.desc: (a) At 45°, launch speeds of 30, 40 and 50 m/s give ranges of 91.8 m, 163 m and 255 m. (b) At 50 m/s, launch angles of 15° and 75° both give a range of 128 m, and 45° gives the maximum range of 255 m. All six projectiles launch together on a shared clock and stop on landing; the animation repeats. The 75° launch rises higher and stays aloft longer than the 15° launch. Air resistance is neglected.
